changelog:
VexZygisk v2.0.0

- KernelSU only: Magisk, APatch, KernelSU-Next and the legacy KernelSU interfaces are gone
- x86 and x86_64 support removed
- 64-bit devices no longer inject the secondary 32-bit Zygote
- WebUI: only home and modules pages remain, the monitor state moved to home under the root implementation, the actions and settings pages are gone
- Amoled is the only WebUI theme and it is always applied
- The WebUI follows the device language
- Dead code cleaned up across the native code and the WebUI
